DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約番号を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Can you show your booking number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この画面です。昨日これを開いたので、予約できたと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約説明の画面を予約の証拠だと思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This screen. I opened it yesterday, so I thought I had made a booking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you mistook the booking instructions screen for proof of a booking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは予約方法の説明です。最後に日時を選び、完了の表示まで進みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This explains how to book. Did you select a date and time at the end and proceed to the completion screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日時の例を見ただけです。自分の名前を入力した覚えもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日時選択や本人情報の入力をしていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only looked at the example dates and times. I don't remember entering my own name either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you did not select a time or enter your personal information. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それでしたら、予約が成立したか確認が必要です。今日はどの相談をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we need to check whether a booking was made. What consultation do you want today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子どもの手続きです。例に出た税の相談とは違うので、同じ予約先でよいかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 例の手続きとは違う相談内容を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: A procedure for my child. It's different from the tax consultation in the example, so I'd also like to check whether the same booking destination is right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your consultation differs from the example procedure. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容によって窓口が違います。先に相談内容を担当者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The counter differs by subject. We'll first check your consultation details with the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。空いている時間を選ぶ前に、子どもの手続きを扱う窓口を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時間選択前に正しい担当窓口を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Before selecting a free time, please tell me the counter handling my child's procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the correct responsible counter before choosing a time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この場面では担当者が内容を伺い、予約が必要かも案内します。今の画面は閉じずに見せられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here, the person responsible will ask the details and explain whether an appointment is needed too. Can you leave this screen open to show them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、そのままにします。説明を読んだだけで、予約完了とは言わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明閲覧と予約完了を区別して担当者に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I'll leave it as it is. I won't say a booking is completed just because I read the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish reading instructions from completing a booking when consulting staff. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。予約未確認の相談として担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll hand this over as a consultation whose booking is unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査のご予約ですね。事前案内はお読みになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have an appointment for a test. Have you read the advance instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日本語を十分に読めませんでした。今朝は普通に朝食を食べています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 事前案内が読めず朝食を食べたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I couldn't read the Japanese well enough. I ate breakfast as usual this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you could not read the instructions and ate breakfast. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食事についての指示を担当者に確認します。何時ごろ、何を召し上がりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the food instructions with the person responsible. Around what time did you eat, and what?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 七時にパンと牛乳です。時間は時計を見たので分かりますが、量は正確ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 食事の時刻と内容を述べ量の不確かさを区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Bread and milk at seven. I know the time because I checked the clock, but not the exact amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the time and food, distinguishing uncertainty about quantity. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。飲み物やお薬についても、案内と実際の状況を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. We'll also compare the instructions and actual situation for drinks and medicines.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 水も飲みました。薬は普段の分を飲んだので、持ってきたお薬手帳を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飲水と服薬を伝え手帳を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I drank water too. I took my usual medicine, so I'll show the medication booklet I brought.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report water and medication and show your booklet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 検査を今日行えるかは、担当者が判断します。受付だけでそのまま進むとは決まりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person responsible will decide whether today's test can proceed. Checking in does not mean it will automatically go ahead.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。食べたことを隠さず伝えて、検査の担当者の説明を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 検査可否を受付で決めず担当者の判断を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll honestly report that I ate and wait for the testing staff's explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not decide at reception whether the test is possible; await the responsible person's decision. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。次回の案内も、分からないところを一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. Let's also check any unclear parts of the instructions for next time together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。食事や薬の条件を理解できる形で聞き、自己判断で薬をやめたりしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今後の条件を確認し薬を自己判断で変更しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'll ask about food and medication conditions in a way I can understand, and won't stop medicine or change it on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check future conditions and say you will not change medicine on your own. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。本日の食事と服薬を担当者へ伝え、説明を受けられるようご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll report today's food and medication to the person responsible and help you receive an explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 目撃した時の状況を教えてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自転車が道路で倒れるところを見ました。近くに車がいたので、車がぶつかったと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転倒を目撃し接触を推測したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw a bicycle fall on the road. A car was nearby, so I thought the car had hit it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you saw the fall and inferred contact. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 接触する瞬間もご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you also see the moment of contact?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、そこは見ていません。見たのは自転車が倒れたことと、車が近くを通ったことです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 実際には接触を見ていないと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I didn't see that. What I saw was the bicycle fall and a car pass nearby.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct yourself that you did not actually see contact. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。見た場所と、お客様がいた位置を説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Can you explain where you saw it and where you were?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 横断歩道の先でした。私は反対側の歩道にいて、間にバスがいた時間もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目撃場所と視界を遮った物を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Beyond the pedestrian crossing. I was on the opposite pavement, and for a while there was a bus between us.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the location and what blocked your view. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 視界が遮られた時間があったのですね。音や言葉については覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: So your view was blocked for a time. Do you remember sounds or words?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 大きな音は聞きましたが、何の音か分かりません。当事者の話は聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 聞いた音と原因不明の範囲を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I heard a loud sound, but don't know what caused it. I didn't hear the people involved talking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the sound you heard from its unknown cause. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。推測と直接見聞きした内容を分けて記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. We'll record inferences separately from what you directly saw and heard.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。車が原因だったと断定せず、自分の位置と見えなかった部分も説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原因を断定せず見聞きした範囲を報告すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't state that the car caused it; I'll also explain my position and what I couldn't see.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you will report what you saw and heard without deciding the cause. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。その内容で担当者へ引き継ぎ、必要な点を改めて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll pass those details to the person responsible and recheck any necessary points.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知のお名前は妹様ですが、お受け取りの荷物は妹様の物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: The notice is addressed to your younger sister. Is the parcel you're collecting hers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の通販の荷物だと思って来ました。妹の名前を見ていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族の宛名を見ず自分の荷物だと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came thinking it was my own online order. I hadn't looked at my sister's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you assumed it was yours without checking the family member's name. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの通知番号と、お客様の注文の荷物は別の可能性があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The parcel with this notice number may differ from your order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の注文画面にある番号とは違います。二枚の通知を玄関で一緒にしてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 注文の番号と通知番号の不一致を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It differs from the number on my order screen. I mixed two notices together at the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the mismatch between the order and notice numbers. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の通知を確認できますか。妹様の荷物は、代理受け取りの条件も別に確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you check your own notice? Your sister's parcel also requires separate checking of proxy-collection conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の通知は家にあると思います。妹の分まで今日受け取るとは決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の通知は家にあり家族分の受領は未決定だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I think my notice is at home. I haven't decided to collect my sister's parcel today too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your own notice is at home and collecting your family member's is undecided. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。今回の通知だけで、ご自身の別の荷物をお渡しすることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We can't hand over your other parcel using only this notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では自分の通知と番号を家で照合します。妹には、妹宛ての通知を持ち出したと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰宅して照合し家族にも持ち出しを知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll compare my own notice and number at home. I'll tell my sister I took her notice out with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare the details at home and tell your family member you took the notice. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。来局前に、宛名と番号を確認していただくと確実です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Checking the addressee and number before visiting is more reliable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日はこの通知で受け取らず、正しい通知を確認してから相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 誤った通知で受け取らず確認後に相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't collect using this notice today; I'll check the correct notice before asking again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to collect with the wrong notice and to consult after checking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通知はお返しします。代理受け取りが必要な場合も先に条件をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll return the notice. If proxy collection is needed, check its conditions first too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの取引について確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which transaction would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃です。通帳に今月の記録がないので、引き落とされなかったなら今から振り込みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通帳にない家賃の記録から追加振込を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The rent. There's no record for this month in my passbook, so if it wasn't debited, I'd like to transfer it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about an additional rent transfer because there is no passbook record. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その通帳は、最後にいつ記帳しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: When did you last update that passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先月です。今月は記帳せず、紙のページだけ見ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後の記帳が先月だったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Last month. This month I only looked at the paper pages without updating it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the last passbook update was last month. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記帳されていないことと、口座で取引が行われていないことは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Not being printed in the passbook differs from no transaction having occurred in the account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二重に払わないよう、先に今月の引き落としを確認したいです。振込はまだ進めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未記帳と未払いを区別し振込を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: To avoid paying twice, I'd like to check this month's debit first. Please don't proceed with a transfer yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish an unupdated passbook from nonpayment and pause the transfer. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。本人確認と取引の照会をご案内します。家賃の請求元は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We'll explain identity verification and transaction enquiries. Do you know who bills the rent?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 契約書にある管理会社です。金額と予定日はこの案内にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 請求元・金額・予定日の資料を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The management company in the contract. The amount and scheduled date are in this notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show documents with the issuer, amount, and scheduled date. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その情報も確認に使いましょう。銀行で分かる取引と、請求元への確認を分けてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's use those details too. We'll distinguish transactions the bank can check from enquiries to the issuer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。記帳と照会の結果を見て、未払いか分かってから管理会社へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 取引照会後に請求元へ確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll look at the update and enquiry results, determine whether it's unpaid, then contact the management company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to check with the issuer after the transaction enquiry. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今回は追加振込を保留し、口座の取引確認へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll pause the additional transfer and help you check account transactions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会計したばかりですが、自分の袋に入れた小さい商品を出し忘れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計直後に袋の未会計商品を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I just paid, but forgot to take out a small product I had put in my own bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report an unpaid item in your bag immediately after checkout. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ店内ですね。その商品とレシートを見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You're still inside the shop, then. Please show the item and receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、この電池です。レシートには載っていないので、別に払いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 商品とレシートを示し支払いを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, these batteries. They're not on the receipt, so I'd like to pay separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the item and receipt and request payment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認します。ほかにも、会計前に袋へ入れた物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check. Did you put anything else in your bag before checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 飴も入れていました。レシートには飴があるので、それは会計済みか照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別の商品も照合し会計済みか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Some sweets too. The receipt includes sweets, so please compare them to confirm they were paid for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare another item too and check whether it was paid for. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: レシートと商品を確認しました。この場面では電池だけが未会計です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've checked the receipt and items. Here, only the batteries are unpaid.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。会計済みの飴まで重ねて払わず、電池だけ会計をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未会計分だけ支払うと確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Please charge only for the batteries, without charging again for the sweets already paid for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm you will pay only for the unpaid items. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらのレジで電池を会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We'll charge for the batteries at this register.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今後は買い物中の商品を自分の袋に入れず、かごで分けて持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今後はかごで未会計品を分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. From now on I'll keep items in a basket separately, not put shopping into my own bag before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separate unpaid items in a basket from now on. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。電池の会計を済ませ、新しいレシートをお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We'll finish the batteries' payment and give you a new receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 集合場所の準備はできましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 看板の前は日なたなので、木の下へ参加者を集めようと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日なたの集合場所を木陰へ移したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's sunny in front of the sign, so I was thinking of gathering the participants under the trees.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss moving the sunny meeting point into shade. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 変更すると、これから来る人が元の場所で探す可能性があります。主催者には相談しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you change it, people arriving later may look at the original point. Have you asked the organizer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。涼しい方がよいと思いましたが、自分だけで場所を変えるのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 主催者に未相談で勝手に変更しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I thought cooler would be better, but I want to avoid changing it by myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not consulted the organizer and will not change it unilaterally. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、主催者に相談し、案内をどう残すか決めましょう。もう参加者は来ていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Let's ask the organizer and decide how to leave directions. Have any participants arrived?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三人来ています。今いる人には、変更が確定したとはまだ伝えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 到着人数と変更を未確定として伝えている状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Three. I haven't told those here that the change is confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the arrival count and that you have not presented the change as confirmed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この場面では、木陰を待機場所にし、元の集合場所に案内担当を置くことになりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here, it's been decided to use the shade as a waiting area and leave a guide at the original meeting point.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では私が元の場所で案内します。来た人を木陰へ誘導し、看板を勝手に移しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元の場所で案内する役割を引き受ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll guide people at the original point. I'll direct arrivals to the shade and won't move the sign myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Take on the role of guiding at the original point. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。開始時刻が近づいたら、主催者に来場状況を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. When the start time approaches, tell the organizer who has arrived.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。未到着の人もいることを伝え、出発を自分で早めずに確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未到着者の状況を報告し開始判断を主催者に任せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll report that some people haven't arrived and check rather than move the departure earlier myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report missing participants and leave the start decision to the organizer. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。待機場所と案内担当は決まりました。開始は主催者がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The waiting place and guide are decided. The organizer will announce the start.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 往復のきっぷをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like a return ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、今日ここから港町へ行き、明日戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 往復を希望する旅行日程を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'll go from here to Minatomachi today and return tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the travel schedule for which you want a return ticket. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 帰りも港町駅からこちらの駅までですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will you return from Minatomachi Station to this station too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 実は友人の家に泊まり、帰りは山手駅から乗ります。出発駅が違っても往復にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰路の乗車駅が違うことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Actually, I'll stay at a friend's house and leave from Yamate Station on the way back. Can it still be a return ticket with a different departure station?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the return journey starts at a different station. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ区間の往復とは条件が違います。まず両日の経路を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The conditions differ from a return over the same section. Let's check the two days' routes separately first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は港町まで、明日は山手からここまでです。帰りの時刻はまだ決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 両日の経路と未確定の帰り時刻を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Today to Minatomachi; tomorrow from Yamate to here. I haven't decided the return time yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Organize both routes and the undecided return time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。今日の片道を先に購入し、帰りは経路と券の条件を別に相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. You can buy today's single ticket first and ask about the return route and ticket conditions separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では今日は片道だけ買います。帰りの駅名をメモして、友人にも山手でよいか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 往路だけ購入し帰路の駅を友人に確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll only buy a single today. I'll note the return station and check with my friend whether Yamate is right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to buy only the outward ticket and check the return station with your friend. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。今、帰りの券まで確定する必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. You don't need to finalize the return ticket now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日の行き先は港町で、山手まで買わないよう確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日購入する片道の行き先を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll check that today's destination is Minatomachi, and avoid buying one to Yamate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the destination of the single ticket purchased today. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。今回は港町までの片道として、経路とお値段をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. This time we'll explain the route and price for a single to Minatomachi.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 前回の相談の続きでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you continuing your previous consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。教えてもらった書類をそろえたので、こちらに提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 以前の相談窓口に書類を提出しようとする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I've gathered the documents you told me about and will submit them here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Try to submit documents at the previous consultation counter. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内の提出先を確認しましょう。ここには別の部署の名前が書かれていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the submission destination in the instructions. A different department is named here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 相談した場所に戻ればいいと思っていました。案内の「提出先」を見落としていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相談場所と案内の提出先を取り違えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I just had to return where I consulted. I overlooked “submission destination” in the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you confused the consultation place with the submission destination. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相談窓口と受付部署は違います。必要な受付時間も案内にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The advice counter and receiving department differ. Do the instructions also give reception hours?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 午後三時までとあります。今は二時半ですが、移動する前に今日受付できるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付時間を示し今日の対応可否を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says until three in the afternoon. It's two thirty now, but before moving I'd like to check whether they can accept them today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the reception hours and check whether today's submission is possible. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当部署に確認します。こちらで預かって提出済みにすることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask the department. We can't keep them here and treat them as submitted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。書類は自分で持ちます。確認後、担当部署へ直接出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 預けず自分で正式な部署へ持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll keep the documents myself. After confirmation, I'll hand them directly to the responsible department.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not leave them but take them to the official department yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この場面では、担当部署へ今日ご案内できます。こちらの案内図をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here, we can direct you to the responsible department today. Please use this map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。向こうで受け付けてもらうまで、提出が終わったとは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内と正式な受理を区別して移動する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I won't consider submission finished until they accept the documents there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish directions from official acceptance and proceed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。案内図と書類を持って、指定の部署へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Take the map and documents and go to the specified department.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 来週の結果説明の予約を確認します。火曜日の午前十時です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll confirm next week's results-explanation appointment: Tuesday at ten in the morning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: その時刻に家で電話を待てばいいですか。結果を電話で聞く予約だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 結果説明を電話で受ける予約か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Should I wait at home for a call then? I thought the appointment was to hear the results by phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the results appointment is by telephone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面の予約は来院して説明を受ける予定です。電話説明の予約ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This appointment is for an explanation in person at the clinic, not by telephone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「結果の連絡」と聞いて、電話だと思っていました。診察室へ来る必要があるんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 来院予定だと理解し誤解の理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I heard “contact about results” and assumed phone. So I need to come to the consultation room.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand it is in person and explain your misunderstanding. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。ご都合は大丈夫でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Does the time suit you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その時間は仕事があります。家で短く電話を受けるつもりだったので、勤務の調整が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 仕事の予定と調整の必要を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have work then. I planned to take a short call at home, so I need to adjust my work schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your work plans and need to adjust. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 日時の変更を相談することもできます。ただし結果の内容を受付が代わりに説明することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can ask to change the appointment. However, reception cannot explain the results instead of the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では変更の候補を教えてください。家族に代わりに聞いてもらえるとは決めず、まず自分の時間を調整します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 代理説明を即決せず本人の予約変更候補を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then please tell me alternative times. I won't assume my family can hear it for me; I'll first adjust my own availability.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for alternative personal appointments without deciding on a proxy explanation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者が予約候補を確認します。今の予約はまだ取り消しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person responsible will check options. We won't cancel your current appointment yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。新しい日時が決まるまで元の予約を残し、来院での説明として予定を立てます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新日時確定までは元予約を残すと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Keep the original until a new time is decided; I'll plan for an in-person explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the original booking remains until a new time is fixed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。来院予定の変更相談として担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll hand this over as a request to change an in-person appointment.
